stages.title: Applicants
stages.what: Deterministic generator turns a seed into fictional members: paper forms with OCR noise, digital JSON payloads, and one injected defect per applicant. Each application also gets a hidden answer key that only the evaluation stage reads.

stages.title: Intake
stages.what: Paper: a model reads the scanned text and must return a verbatim evidence quote for every value; a value it cannot quote is capped at low confidence and flagged. Digital: fields are copied as submitted, no model call.
stages.example: APP-20261015-001 2026-10-15: intake_parsed - fields parsed, flagged none, 0 evidence issue(s)

stages.title: Processor and mock CMS
stages.what: Signature, required fields and PCP completeness are checked first. A complete application is submitted to the mock CMS, whose fixed-order checks answer with ACC, DUP or a REJ-* code.
stages.example: APP-20261015-001 2026-10-15: cms_response - REJ-AREA - Member's county is outside the plan's service area

stages.title: CMS reply
stages.what: ACC and DUP finalise the case; every other code routes it to the work basket with that code as the reason. Reply codes are simplified stand-ins, not real CMS transaction codes.
stages.example: APP-20261015-001 2026-10-15: cms_response - REJ-AREA - Member's county is outside the plan's service area

stages.title: Work basket
stages.short: Route the case to a queue
stages.what: Cases land in one queue with the reason printed on them: missing information, low-confidence OCR fields, or the CMS reply code. The queue is worked oldest first under a daily capacity.

stages.title: Resolver
stages.short: Fix it, ask for it, or deny it
stages.what: A model picks FIX, CONFIRM, REQUEST_INFO, DENY or ESCALATE. A fix only lands if its evidence quote is really in the document; a denial needs a second deterministic gate and is blocked when the paperwork hints the member may qualify.
stages.example: APP-20261015-001 2026-10-15: decision - chose DENY (confidence 0.98): Application was rejected because the selected plan's service area does not include the me…

stages.title: Notices
stages.what: One letter per outcome (ACCEPT, DENY, RFI, CLOSED_INCOMPLETE). The compliance agent checks the required phrases and rejects the letter for a redo; a fallback template is used if the model keeps failing.
stages.example: APP-20261015-001 2026-10-15: letter_issued - DENY letter from openai, workspace/letters/APP-20261015-001_DENY.txt

stages.title: Compliance and audit
stages.short: Re-derive the day from the evidence
stages.what: Deterministic checks escalate the gate (S1 = zero tolerance); an LLM review of a sample is advisory only. Then every case is scored against the hidden answer key: accuracy, false accepts, false denials.

disclaimer: Synthetic data only. Every person, Medicare number and plan is fictional and generated from a seed; member IDs, plan IDs and case IDs carry the SYN or APP prefix. The CMS reply codes, election windows, denial reasons and notice wording are simplified stand-ins defined in this repository's config/policy.json - they are NOT real CMS transaction codes or CMS rules, and nothing here is a compliance determination. The 'expected' value shown per case is this simulation's own answer key for scoring accuracy, not a legal outcome. In mock mode the agents are deterministic parsers: the numbers prove the plumbing, guards and audit trail, not model quality.
